description: Implementation of string splitting utilities in the Abseil C++ library, including classes for finding delimiters within strings.

classes.name: ByString
classes.description: Class for finding a substring delimiter within a string.

classes.name: ByChar
classes.description: Class for finding a specific character within a string.

classes.name: ByAnyChar
classes.description: Class for finding any character from a set of delimiters within a string.

classes.name: ByLength
classes.description: Class for finding a position based on a fixed length offset.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Method to locate the delimiter within a string starting from a given position.
